requirements.description: Prove the full error theorem for arbitrary real functions f, D and real x, h, L satisfying the stated hypotheses.
Use continuity on the closed interval and actual derivative D(t) on the open interval.
Use the pointwise absolute variation bound relative to D(x) on the open interval.
Prove an absolute error at most L*h between the defined forward difference and D(x).
Use only the specified hypotheses, including h > 0 and L >= 0, without requiring derivatives at endpoints or global smoothness.

defect_categories.description: The requested final proposition is not proved.
A requested construction has no actual definition.
A construction differs from the specified algorithm or recurrence.
The proof is about the wrong quantity or does not connect to the construction.
The asserted error bound is weaker than or different from the requested bound.
The theorem adds a premise absent from the task.
The desired conclusion or an equivalent statement is assumed.
The theorem covers fewer inputs than the task requires.

construction_policy: Supply an actual forward-difference definition and a theorem about that definition. D(x) is the reference value. The open interval is sufficient for the derivative and variation hypotheses.
